calendar_pairing.generation: TrafficPlan creates the complete F21/F22 event list at initialization, before the event loop, on dedicated RNG streams 0 and 1.
calendar_pairing.verification: Save the first events.csv as the seed calendar and require byte-identical canonical event rows/SHA-256 for every treatment at that seed. Same seed without the signature check is insufficient.

retention.raw_cleanup: Only after a successful compact and temporal extraction; retain no multi-GB raw vectors by default.

candidate_schedule: Candidates 1-12: one deterministic +up-to-10%-of-port-rate coordinate step at a time, keeping prior increments and choosing from egress/TC targets on currently failing flows by the registered measured-wait order.
Candidates 13-18: coupled +up-to-10%-of-port-rate steps on all eligible TC/egress queues along one currently failing flow path, ordered by the same wait/routing rule.

Candidates 19-24: deterministic backtracking from the best prior nonviable candidate (fewest high-hard misses, then all-flow deadline misses, confirmed drops, worst queue wait, then earlier candidate index), reducing one adjusted target by 2% of its port rate while retaining the other coupled settings; never below nominal.

If any candidate is viable, stop the viability search and perform at most 12 reductions by 2% of port rate, in descending excess-over-nominal then measured-wait order; keep only candidates passing every P1 gate.
Reject before simulation and record any candidate that would exceed 75% total CBS on any egress; if no positive increment remains, do not run it.
search.failure_wording: If no candidate among the defined search is viable, report 'nenhum candidato viável encontrado pela busca exploratória definida'; do not infer general impossibility.

targets.historical_note: The pre-correction target list is preserved in results/archive/pre_correction/search_protocol_pre_correction.json; historical search_history and run profiles were not rewritten.
targets.priority_order: Within still-failing paths, sort by measured queueingTime.max descending, then mean descending, then fixed source-to-destination route order and egress name.

route_metadata_correction.reason: HPC is destination for F01/F06/F07, not a traversed egress

search.viability: All P1 hard/soft deadline, packet loss, received-delivery/goodput and stable-queue criteria; no p99-only acceptance.

temporal_evidence.camera: image release times and imageCompletionLatency; active release span marked separately
temporal_evidence.interpretation: temporal association only; no packet-level causal attribution without per-packet route tracing
temporal_evidence.queue_traces: 1 ms occupancy summaries on HPC, CSW.eth[0], Z1/Z2/Z3 uplinks and affected talker ports
temporal_evidence.sensor_latency: per-packet receiver latency vectors; misses binned by event/creation time
temporal_evidence.transients: F21/F22 event intervals from identical calendar
